walkthrough: Goal (S101: the test crops imported first, so a combination copies a crop): copy single shapes (V大's 复制单体图形) from a practice pack and from pictures of my own, the way week 2 asks: see the whole silhouette, place its ends in the frame, check the negative shapes, the big masses before the detail; then compare my line drawing with the picture's outline, in place and aligned. And move on to stage 2 before stage 1's fifteen sessions are done.

Packs: in the gallery the Today card has an options button under it, beside 'Practice'. It opens the practice options: the stages I can move to (Stage 2 · Single shapes, Start), the practice packs kept (none yet: 'single shapes copy a pack's pictures'), Import practice pack… and Add my picture…. Import practice pack… opens the system's file picker; I choose the pack file; a notice says it is imported and its pictures come up in single shapes. A file that is no pack is refused with a notice and nothing changes; cancelling changes nothing.

My pictures: Add my picture… asks how hard it is to copy (S83); I tap Simple and the picture picker opens; I choose a picture of my own. It goes into My pictures, kept only on this tablet, never mixed with the pack; the notice says whether its outline was found (Compare lays the outline over my copy) or not (Compare lays the picture itself over my copy, faint). The options now list the pack (its pictures, how many with an outline) and My pictures.

Stage 2 early: in the options I tap Stage 2 · Single shapes. A session of stage 2 starts at once: four single shapes (entry and simple ones in my first sessions, harder ones mixed in as sessions go, the last one of my own pictures), then week 2's colour work (a colour combination, a value scale) and its perspective (a box to complete and an ellipse; free boxes in the next session), about 30 minutes. Nothing was compared before, so there is no warm-up.

The exercise: the picture sits in its frame at the left, the empty frame beside it; a picture under a licence that asks for credit has its credit in small print under its frame. The first time shapes come up their instructions show by themselves: copy the outline as a line drawing, not too fine but accurate; see the whole silhouette first and mark its top, bottom, left and right ends lightly with Sketch; the big masses and long lines before the small turns, checking the negative shapes; then Draw, and Compare.
Copy: I mark the ends with Sketch, then draw the outline with Draw, a little off and a little small as a hand is, and a line inside it (a fold).

Compare: the picture lies faint over my copy with its outline in red, in place, so where I placed it shows. Aligned: the outline moves and sizes onto my lines (never turned; the line inside and the sketch marks do not pull it), the picture with it; while the fit is found the card says so, and nothing stalls. The pen is blue: I correct the worst side in blue; the red goes as my pen lands; Compare again: the red comes back over the corrected copy.
A picture without an outline (a busy ground): Compare lays the picture faint in place; Aligned is greyed and the card says why.
Chinese: All tools, Actions, 中文: the bar reads '单体图形 1/4', the card says 原位 and 对齐; back in English.

Summary: Finish shows the whole sheet with every picture and its credit; the card counts shapes, colour combinations, value scales, boxes and ellipses compared. In the gallery the Today card now reads Stage 2 · Single shapes, and its options offer Stage 1 to revisit.

Not here: a picture deleted from My pictures or moved to another tier (s83-practice-polish); numbers for shapes (the overlay is the feedback); week 2's colour work (s82-colour-work); its perspective boxes and ellipses (s84-perspective); analyses (their slices).
